discovery.found_by: the 6 production adaptations the census listed under 'Unchecked leads (traversal NEVER run)'

scope: All 6 production-adaptation rows: jadhavspeaks/file_compare_diffrent_ext, ProgrammeVitam/sedatools, morpheus45/gsystem, tpunder/fm-flatfile, MarDream/demand_system x2. Five distinct projects.

why_excluded.finding: Split between born-past-boundary and not-declared, and all six additionally change no library-referencing code.
why_excluded.born_past_boundary: jadhavspeaks/file_compare_diffrent_ext and both MarDream/demand_system rows declare poi-scratchpad 5.2.5 at BOTH the commit and its parent. The boundary is 5.0.0, so these projects were already well past it and never crossed. A restrictive default met by a project born above it is a latent bug, not a break it lived through.
why_excluded.not_declared: ProgrammeVitam/sedatools, morpheus45/gsystem and tpunder/fm-flatfile have version_at_commit and version_at_parent None -- no direct declaration, so out of scope under the direct-only rule.
why_excluded.no_library_code_changed: library_referenced_files is EMPTY for all six.
why_excluded.note_on_jadhavspeaks: This repo is already the subject of verified_cases/.../poi-jadhavspeaks.json for the poi (not poi-scratchpad) break. The poi-scratchpad row is a separate artifact of the same project and does not add a case.
